title: Amarillo Is Officially One of the Most Haunted Cities in Texas
excerpt: Spooky season is almost over, but Amarillo’s ghosts are not done yet. Find out where we landed in a new haunted cities ranking and who took the top spot
content:
As the spooky season is winding down and we are upon Halloween and Día de los Muertos, it's crazy to realize that Amarillo is haunted. The classic haunts include the Nat, the Garvey Grain Elevators, the former York Tire building, and the Seven Gates of Hell.

How Hard Rock Bet Ranked the Most Haunted States

A new study by Hard Rock Bet found that Texas is the #2 most haunted state in the US. Hard Rock Bet looked at different factors to determine which state was the most haunted. Those factors include:

  • Haunted locations
  • Ghost towns
  • UFO sightings
  • Bigfoot sightings
  • Ghost sightings

Amarillo Ranks #6 Among Texas Cities for Ghost Sightings

Out of all the Texas cities that face these hauntings, Amarillo is in the top 10. In fact, Amarillo ranked #6 on the list of the most haunted cities in Texas. Amarillo has 70 ghost sightings. El Paso ranked #1 with 197 ghost sightings.
